punchline: Two rats took the same shocks, and the one that was warned first developed far fewer ulcers.
thirty_sec: In an experiment Sapolsky describes, two rats got identical shocks, but one heard a warning signal first. That rat developed far fewer ulcers. Same shock, different predictability. He lists predictability, a sense of control, an outlet for frustration, social support and a sense that things are not getting worse as the factors that shape stress.
